title: Vice President of Manufacturing
text:
**Job Overview**

VP of Manufacturing | Race City Steel

**Location** 
Iron Station, NC

**Reports to** 
VP of Operations and President

About the Role

Race City Steel is hiring a VP of Manufacturing to lead our Iron Station fabrication operation. You’ll manage the fabrication sales and shop floor teams, working directly with the Shop Foreman to improve productivity, quality, and on-time delivery.

Our fabrication shop provides value-added services to Race City Steel’s metal service center locations. The shop handles everything from quick-turn, just-in-time cutting and forming to large, multi-step fabrication orders. You’ll build the processes and capacity to handle both while keeping delivery commitments clear and achievable.

Key Responsibilities

* Lead and develop the fabrication sales and shop floor teams. Set clear expectations for communication, quality, productivity, and follow-through.
* Partner with the Shop Foreman on daily priorities, labor assignments, production scheduling, and bottlenecks. Adjust the schedule as rush orders and customer needs change.
* Coordinate with fabrication sales and branch sales teams to review job requirements, confirm capacity and lead times, and communicate changes before they affect customer commitments.
* Serve as the point of accountability for all machine maintenance, troubleshooting, calibration, and performance. Coordinate preventive maintenance, repairs, and outside service for flat lasers, tube lasers, press brakes, welding equipment, and other fabrication machinery.
* Create and improve processes from quote and order handoff through material staging, production, inspection, and shipping.
* Improve warehouse organization, material flow, and job staging so operators have the material, tooling, and information they need when a job is ready to run.
* Establish consistent quality standards and inspection practices. Address recurring defects and rework with the sales and production teams.
* Track on-time delivery, machine uptime, labor productivity, and rework. Use those measures to identify bottlenecks and follow through on improvements.
* Maintain safe work practices and consistent operating standards across the facility.

Qualifications

* Leadership experience in metal fabrication, manufacturing, or a related industrial operation.
* Working knowledge of laser cutting, tube laser cutting, press brake forming, welding, and related fabrication processes.
* Experience leading shop floor teams and coordinating with sales on job requirements, capacity, and customer delivery dates.
* Experience overseeing equipment maintenance and troubleshooting, including working with technicians and outside service providers.
* Ability to read fabrication drawings, understand job requirements, and build practical processes for a shop with changing priorities.
* Strong communication and organizational skills, with the ability to make decisions and follow through from the sales office to the shop floor.

Pay: $85,800.00 - $120,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person
